fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-11-19, the complainant was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Arasu Nagar Residential Colony after a dispute over a personal disagreement. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-11-17 around 00:25 hrs. Lakshmi Raman submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000082. Vasanth Chandran (9000000408) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A grey van with registration TN-33-XX-1030 was observed near Arasu Nagar Residential Colony. The complaint refers to Suresh Selvam, a co-worker, reachable on 9000000005. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Kannan Shankar, using the number 9000000415. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, witness, van, residential colony, night, mobile number, associate
